KEN.note: Says IEBC servers are hosted in data centres outside Kenya; states no data centre for hire in Kenya.
Mentions the Data Protection Act only as a qualifier in an amendment; states nothing on its standing, authority, regulations or application.

facts.fact: The article says Smartmatic supplied KIEMS kits used for biometric voter registration, electronic voter identification and result transmission in Kenya's 2022 general election, and that IEBC is targeting 6.3 million new voters ahead of 2027.

KEN.note: States nothing about a national ID system.
States only that IEBC servers are hosted in data centres outside Kenya; no nationally owned data centre for hire.
